long_biography.plain_text:
Russian businessman Mikhail Shelkov created the Empathy Foundation to support teachers, arguing that their influence on children deserved practical recognition. Its first programme provided financial assistance to educators. For a subsequent psychology workshop, he wanted teachers and parents to choose discussion topics rather than have a professional development path imposed on them.

In Tula, Shelkov partnered with Rostec on the Oktava creative cluster. The centre combines a technical school with exhibitions, a library and a museum devoted to industrial machinery. Its practical workshop teaches visitors to prepare designs for laser cutting and also offers a 3D printer.

In Tula, Shelkov partnered with Rostec on the Oktava creative cluster. The centre combines a technical school with exhibitions, a library and a museum devoted to industrial machinery. Its practical workshop teaches visitors to prepare designs for laser cutting and also offers a 3D printer.
